investigator_notes:
Found by the daily catalog crawl on 2026-10-23, which matches product titles against every name in the Master Trademark Filing Chart rather than Registered and Pending only (user instruction, 2026-09-18). This record's chart entry is "Registered". The product title contains the single word "BARONESSE", which is the whole of the chart entry. A one-word match can be coincidence rather than the variety -- it needs a human read of the listing before it means anything.

Observation for human review, recorded 2026-10-23: the match classification is Possible because that rating is decided mechanically -- the chart entry "BARONESSE" is a single word, and a single ordinary word inside a longer title can be coincidence. In this case the surrounding words are not neutral: the listing is titled "Germany Tantau Baronesse", and Rosen Tantau KG is the registered owner of BARONESSE (Reg. No. 7593983) and the breeder on this case record. The seller naming the breeder alongside the mark is a fact about the listing, not a finding of infringement, and the classifier cannot see it because it compares names only. Flagged so the Possible rating is not read as the whole picture.
